audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty was described in generic 'burst and stun' terms with no range or cooldown anywhere, and the packet flags zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: Shield Vault is a 600-range targeted dash-stun on 13/12/11/10/9s. Breath of Light is a 750-range interruptible channel. That 600 is the line the whole lane is played off.
audit.corrected: Difficulty stated as the 600-range dash-stun against two interruptible channels: you may only start the beam once Shield Vault is spent, and its 13 seconds at rank 1 is the window.

audit.whatIsWrong: His ultimate was called 'Grand Skyfall' in three places, and Aurelion Sol's abilities were called 'Q Starfire' and 'Voice of Light'.
audit.why: It is Grand Starfall, 180/165/150s at 5500 range. Aurelion Sol's are Breath of Light (750) and Falling Star / The Skies Descend (120/110/100s).
audit.corrected: Names corrected and the real numbers used: a 180s drop-in at level 6, first item as your inflection, and The Skies Descend as the endgame.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two interactions that decide this matchup were absent: Aegis Assault is a channel your stun cancels, and it only blocks damage from the front.
audit.why: Riot's Aegis Assault text: 'Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear', and the kit flags it as an interruptible channel on 22/21/20/19/18s. Falling Star's stun therefore ends it outright, and a beam held on his flank is not blocked by it.
audit.corrected: State both: Falling Star cancels Aegis Assault, and the shield faces one way — burn him from the side rather than pouring the beam into the front of it. In the other direction, Shield Vault's stun cancels Breath of Light and Astral Flight, so the beam only starts after his dash is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: Catalogue defect 3. Real numbers: Shield Vault 13s at rank 1, Aegis Assault 22s at rank 1, Comet Spear 11s at rank 1, Grand Starfall 180s at rank 1, Astral Flight 22s.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around those numbers with an explicit wait-then-act line.

audit.why: 50.91% over 605 games matches a lane lost early and reclaimed on scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-layer chart disagreement on rows 6 and 7: phases[5].side read 'Pantheon' and phases[6].side read 'Skill' while win[5] and win[6] both read 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: Same row, two answers. The content layer matches the kit — his damage is front-loaded and stardust is permanent.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side -> Aurelion Sol, with ratings and whys rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles, and dosFull[2].d described his cooldown under a title about saving your ultimate.
audit.corrected: All three bodies rewritten to match their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

notes: Fabricated name 'Grand Skyfall' corrected to Grand Starfall in three places (whys[4], mid, wants.you[0], wants.foe[1]); 'Q Starfire' and 'Voice of Light' are not Aurelion Sol abilities and were replaced with Breath of Light and The Skies Descend. Two decisive interactions added that the page never carried: Aegis Assault is a channel, so Falling Star's stun cancels it outright, and Riot's own text says he is invulnerable to damage FROM THE FRONT only — a beam on his flank is not blocked, which is the single most useful thing in this matchup. In the other direction Shield Vault's stun cancels Breath of Light and Astral Flight. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit at all and now carries Shield Vault 13s, Aegis Assault 22s and Grand Starfall 180s. Cross-layer chart disagreement fixed on rows 6 and 7. Not asserted: the _missing entry claiming Astral Flight 'shuts off' Shield Vault and Grand Starfall — that rests on a terrain flag which contradicts Riot's text (Aurelion Sol flies OVER terrain, he does not create it), so only the spacing value of the 1500-range flight is claimed.
